description: List tables and columns staged on a DataCanvas from a prior fx_get_timeseries call. Required first step before fx_dataframe_query — use it to discover table names and column schemas. Requires DataCanvas, which is on by default — a deployment that turns it off does not list this tool at all, and fx_get_timeseries returns every range inline there.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by fx_get_timeseries. Re-run fx_get_timeseries to obtain a fresh canvas_id if this one has expired.

name: fx_dataframe_describe

canvas_id.description: The canvas ID echoed back — use this in fx_dataframe_query.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_not_found`: canvas_id does not exist or has been evicted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this canvas will be evicted.

tables.description: All tables and views currently staged on this canvas.

items.description: A single table or view staged on the canvas.

nullable.description: Whether the column accepts NULL values.

type.description: DuckDB column type (e.g. VARCHAR, DOUBLE, BIGINT).

row_count.description: Number of rows in this table or view.

title: Fx Dataframe Describe
